title.en: What Is a Research Operating System?

dek.en: A working architecture for turning a research objective into an inspectable, executable, and accountable loop.
dek.zh: 把 Research Objective 变成可检查、可执行、可问责 Loop 的工作架构。

audience.en: For researchers designing Auto Research, Vibe Research, or agentic scientific infrastructure.
audience.zh: 面向设计 Auto Research、Vibe Research 或 Agentic Scientific Infrastructure 的研究者。

text.en: A Research Operating System is the durable substrate that turns a research objective into an inspectable, executable, and accountable loop. It is not a bigger prompt and it is not synonymous with an autonomous scientist. The object of design is the loop: what state is preserved, what actions are executable, what evaluator can reject a claim, and where a human can intervene.
text.zh: Research Operating System 是把 Research Objective 转化为可检查、可执行、可问责 Loop 的持久底座。它不是更长的 Prompt，也不等同于 Autonomous Scientist。设计对象是 Loop：保存什么 State、哪些 Action 可以执行、哪个 Evaluator 可以拒绝 Claim，以及 Human 在哪里介入。

text.en: Throughput can be delegated; epistemic accountability cannot be assumed.
text.zh: Throughput 可以委托，但 Epistemic Accountability 不能被默认拥有。

title.en: Three layers of a Research OS

description.en: Brief, evidence, memory, artifacts, provenance, Git

heading.en: Auto Research, Vibe Research, and Research OS
heading.zh: Auto Research、Vibe Research 与 Research OS 的边界

values.en: Agents carry a larger share of the iterative research loop.
values.zh: Agent 承担更大范围的 Iterative Research Loop。

values.en: Does not imply novelty, judgment, or replication.
values.zh: 不自动意味着 Novelty、Judgment 或 Replication。

values.en: Humans keep direction, taste, and critical judgment; agents supply throughput.
values.zh: Human 保留 Direction、Taste 与 Critical Judgment；Agent 提供 Throughput。

values.en: A collaboration mode, not an autonomy grade.
values.zh: 它是协作模式，不是 Autonomy Grade。

values.en: The substrate that stores state, drives execution, and constrains accountability.
values.zh: 保存 State、驱动 Execution、约束 Accountability 的系统底座。

values.en: Can support either human-led or more autonomous workflows.
values.zh: 既可支持 Human-led，也可支持更 Autonomous 的 Workflow。

text.en: The distinction matters because a polished interface can hide a weak evidence chain. A Research OS should make the boundary visible: which decisions came from a person, which came from an agent, and which were accepted only after an external check.
text.zh: 这个区分很重要，因为精致 Interface 可能掩盖薄弱的 Evidence Chain。Research OS 应该让边界可见：哪些 Decision 来自人，哪些来自 Agent，哪些只有经过 External Check 才被接受。

heading.en: State Layer: durable state beats a longer prompt
heading.zh: State Layer：持久 State 胜过更长 Prompt

text.en: Research is a sequence of changing commitments. A durable State Layer records the research brief, source identity, evidence status, failed attempts, decision context, artifact lineage, and the version of every executable object. This lets a later action answer not only what was said, but what was tried, what was falsified, and what remains uncertain.
text.zh: Research 是一系列不断变化的 Commitment。持久 State Layer 记录 Research Brief、Source Identity、Evidence Status、Failed Attempt、Decision Context、Artifact Lineage，以及每个可执行对象的 Version。这样后续 Action 不仅能回答“说过什么”，还可以回答“试过什么、否证了什么、什么仍不确定”。

items.en: Evidence objects: source, excerpt, claim scope, timestamp, and provenance.
items.zh: Evidence Object：Source、Excerpt、Claim Scope、Timestamp 与 Provenance。

items.en: Findings memory: observation, interpretation, confidence, contradiction, and next test.
items.zh: Findings Memory：Observation、Interpretation、Confidence、Contradiction 与 Next Test。

items.en: Artifact lineage: code, data, environment, evaluator output, and reproducible identifier.
items.zh: Artifact Lineage：Code、Data、Environment、Evaluator Output 与可复现 Identifier。

items.en: Decision context: alternatives considered, rejected paths, budget, and human ownership.
items.zh: Decision Context：考虑过的 Alternative、Rejected Path、Budget 与 Human Ownership。

text.en: If deleting the chat transcript destroys the experiment history, the system has context, not durable research state.
text.zh: 如果删除 Chat Transcript 就会摧毁 Experiment History，那么系统拥有的是 Context，而不是 Durable Research State。

heading.en: Execution Layer: tools, environments, evaluators, and replay

text.en: An execution layer turns an idea into a controlled intervention. It defines tool permissions, sandbox boundaries, data access, resource budgets, evaluator ownership, and replay semantics. The evaluator should be external to the proposal whenever possible: a fixed metric, a held-out dataset, a parser, a proof checker, a physical instrument, or a preregistered human protocol.
text.zh: Execution Layer 把 Idea 变成受控 Intervention。它定义 Tool Permission、Sandbox Boundary、Data Access、Resource Budget、Evaluator Ownership 与 Replay Semantics。只要可能，Evaluator 应与 Proposal 解耦：Fixed Metric、Held-out Dataset、Parser、Proof Checker、Physical Instrument 或 Preregistered Human Protocol。

items.en: Make permissions and failure modes explicit before a run starts.
items.zh: 在 Run 开始前明确 Permission 与 Failure Mode。

items.en: Persist the exact environment and evaluator version with every artifact.
items.zh: 为每个 Artifact 保存 Exact Environment 与 Evaluator Version。

items.en: Separate inner feedback from untouched outer evidence.
items.zh: 区分 Inner Feedback 与 Untouched Outer Evidence。

items.en: Treat replay as a first-class operation, not a post-hoc aspiration.
items.zh: 把 Replay 当作一等 Operation，而不是事后愿望。

heading.en: Control Layer: topology, handoff, and human oversight

text.en: The Control Layer decides who acts next, what information crosses a boundary, and when a person must review. Agent Topology is therefore a policy variable, not a decorative diagram. A single agent may be efficient for a narrow loop; parallel workers may widen exploration; role-specialized teams may improve coverage while increasing handoff and credit-assignment risk.
text.zh: Control Layer 决定谁接下来行动、哪些信息跨越边界，以及何时必须由 Human Review。因此 Agent Topology 是 Policy Variable，而不是装饰性 Diagram。Single Agent 可能适合 Narrow Loop；Parallel Worker 可以扩大 Exploration；Role-specialized Team 可能改善 Coverage，但也会增加 Handoff 与 Credit-assignment Risk。

description.zh: 可测试 Intervention 与 Budget

text.en: Human oversight is strongest when it is signal-triggered and artifact-aware: a person reviews when uncertainty, contradiction, safety risk, evaluator drift, or an irreversible action crosses a declared threshold.
text.zh: Human Oversight 在 Signal-triggered 且 Artifact-aware 时最有力：当 Uncertainty、Contradiction、Safety Risk、Evaluator Drift 或不可逆 Action 超过预先声明的 Threshold 时，由人 Review。

heading.en: What this concept does not claim

items.en: It does not claim that persistent memory creates scientific understanding.
items.zh: 它不声称 Persistent Memory 会自动产生 Scientific Understanding。

items.en: It does not claim that an end-to-end workflow has discovered genuinely new knowledge.
items.zh: 它不声称 End-to-end Workflow 已发现 Genuine New Knowledge。

items.en: It does not turn peer review, an LLM judge, or a product demo into independent replication.
items.zh: 它不会把 Peer Review、LLM Judge 或 Product Demo 变成 Independent Replication。

items.en: It is a working synthesis for system design, not a settled academic taxonomy.
items.zh: 它是用于 System Design 的 Working Synthesis，不是已经统一的 Academic Taxonomy。

text.en: The Research OS lens organizes public evidence; it does not upgrade the evidence grade of any linked system.
text.zh: Research OS Lens 只组织公开证据，不会提升任何链接 System 的 Evidence Grade。

heading.en: DeepScientist as a public architecture case study
heading.zh: DeepScientist：一个公开架构 Case Study

text.en: DeepScientist is included here only as a public architecture case study. Its public guides expose a layered runtime, prompt and skill interfaces, MCP-connected tools, and memory/artifact conventions that are useful for discussing State, Execution, and Control. The case study is not a claim that the product has independently validated autonomous scientific novelty.
text.zh: 这里只把 DeepScientist 作为公开架构 Case Study。其公开 Guide 展示了分层 Runtime、Prompt 与 Skill Interface、MCP-connected Tool，以及 Memory/Artifact Convention，可用于讨论 State、Execution 与 Control。这个 Case Study 不声称产品已经 Independent Validate Autonomous Scientific Novelty。

columns.en: Not established by the case study

values.en: Runtime, skills, prompts, MCP, memory, and artifact boundaries.
values.zh: Runtime、Skill、Prompt、MCP、Memory 与 Artifact Boundary。

values.en: Independent scientific replication or broad novelty.
values.zh: Independent Scientific Replication 或 Broad Novelty。

label.zh: 在本 Atlas 中的用途

values.en: Concrete vocabulary for the Research OS layers.
values.zh: 为 Research OS Layer 提供具体 Vocabulary。

values.en: Not a product procurement recommendation.
values.zh: 不是 Product Procurement Recommendation。

scope.en: Runtime, tools, skills, prompts, memory, and artifact boundaries described in public documentation.
scope.zh: 公开文档描述的 Runtime、Tool、Skill、Prompt、Memory 与 Artifact Boundary。

boundary.en: Architecture visibility is not independent validation of scientific novelty or reproducibility.
boundary.zh: Architecture Visibility 不等于 Scientific Novelty 或 Reproducibility 的 Independent Validation。

title.en: How to Evaluate a Research Operating System?
title.zh: 如何评估一个 Research Operating System？

dek.en: A final score is one observation. Trustworthy evidence is a ladder of artifacts, traces, holdouts, replay, and replication.
dek.zh: Final Score 只是一个 Observation；Trustworthy Evidence 是由 Artifact、Trace、Holdout、Replay 与 Replication 构成的阶梯。

audience.en: For benchmark designers, system builders, and reviewers who need comparable evidence without false precision.
audience.zh: 面向 Benchmark Designer、System Builder 与需要避免 False Precision 的 Reviewer。

heading.en: A final score is not the evidence
heading.zh: Final Score 不是全部证据

text.en: A terminal metric answers whether one run ended above a threshold. It rarely tells us whether the agent framed the problem correctly, reused experience, selected the right tool, fabricated a result, or would fail on an untouched task. A Research OS evaluation therefore needs to expose the process that produced the score.
text.zh: Terminal Metric 只能回答某次 Run 是否超过 Threshold。它通常不能告诉我们 Agent 是否正确 Framing Problem、Reuse Experience、选择正确 Tool、Fabricate Result，或在 Untouched Task 上失败。因此 Research OS Evaluation 必须暴露产生 Score 的 Process。

text.en: Measure the claim, the artifact, and the path—not only the endpoint.
text.zh: 同时测量 Claim、Artifact 与 Path，而不只是 Endpoint。

title.en: From task success to independent replication
title.zh: 从 Task Success 到 Independent Replication

description.en: Outputs parse, run, and match the task contract.
description.zh: Output 可 Parse、可 Run，并符合 Task Contract。

description.en: Intermediate decisions and failures are inspectable.
description.zh: Intermediate Decision 与 Failure 可检查。

description.en: The outer evidence was not searched during tuning.
description.zh: Outer Evidence 未在 Tuning 期间被搜索。

description.en: Another operator can rerun the released artifact.
description.zh: 另一 Operator 可以重跑 Released Artifact。

description.en: A separate team confirms the scientific finding.
description.zh: 独立 Team 确认 Scientific Finding。

text.en: The levels are cumulative in spirit, not automatic. A peer-reviewed article may have strong task and artifact evidence while still lacking independent replay or replication.
text.zh: 这些层级在精神上是递进的，但不是自动累积的。Peer-reviewed Article 可能有很强的 Task 与 Artifact Evidence，却仍缺少 Independent Replay 或 Replication。

text.en: Comparisons are only meaningful when the budget is explicit. Report model family, token budget, wall-clock time, tool calls, sandbox compute, and human minutes. If one system gets more retries, more context, or more expert intervention, the comparison basis has changed.
text.zh: 只有明确 Budget，比较才有意义。报告 Model Family、Token Budget、Wall-clock Time、Tool Call、Sandbox Compute 与 Human Minute。如果一个 System 获得更多 Retry、Context 或 Expert Intervention，Comparison Basis 就已经改变。

items.en: Model budget: model, context, sampling, and retry policy.
items.zh: Model Budget：Model、Context、Sampling 与 Retry Policy。

items.en: Execution budget: wall-clock, hardware, tool calls, and environment resets.
items.zh: Execution Budget：Wall-clock、Hardware、Tool Call 与 Environment Reset。

items.en: Human budget: minutes, intervention policy, expertise, and review depth.
items.zh: Human Budget：Minute、Intervention Policy、Expertise 与 Review Depth。

items.en: Evidence budget: number of repeats, holdouts, and independent operators.
items.zh: Evidence Budget：Repeat、Holdout 与 Independent Operator 数量。

values.en: Retrieval, antecedent recovery, and source grounding.
values.zh: Retrieval、Antecedent Recovery 与 Source Grounding。

values.en: Genuine novelty or exhaustive coverage.
values.zh: Genuine Novelty 或 Exhaustive Coverage。

values.en: Correct execution against a specified analysis plan.
values.zh: 在指定 Analysis Plan 下正确执行。

values.en: Question selection or causal judgment.
values.zh: Question Selection 或 Causal Judgment。

values.en: Reproducible intervention under a fixed evaluator.
values.zh: Fixed Evaluator 下的可复现 Intervention。

values.en: Transferable scientific insight.
values.zh: Transferable Scientific Insight。

values.en: Search breadth, recovery, and candidate generation.
values.zh: Search Breadth、Recovery 与 Candidate Generation。

values.en: Independent new knowledge.
values.zh: Independent New Knowledge。

values.en: A preregistered novelty protocol and explicit prior-art test.
values.zh: Preregistered Novelty Protocol 与 Explicit Prior-art Test。

values.en: Truth without replication and domain review.
values.zh: 没有 Replication 与 Domain Review 的 Truth。

heading.en: Noise Floor, repeats, and negative results

text.en: An improvement is credible only relative to the noise of the environment. Estimate a noise floor, repeat independent seeds, preserve negative results, and replay the artifact after the agent has stopped searching. A benchmark that keeps only the best run creates a selection-bias feedback loop.
text.zh: 只有相对于 Environment Noise，一个 Improvement 才可信。应估计 Noise Floor、重复 Independent Seed、保留 Negative Result，并在 Agent 停止 Search 后 Replay Artifact。只保留 Best Run 的 Benchmark 会制造 Selection-bias Feedback Loop。

text.en: Review should inspect the object that carries the claim: code, data transformation, figures, logs, proofs, protocols, or instrument traces. Stepwise verification localizes failure before a fluent final narrative can hide it. This is especially important when an LLM judge is part of the evaluator.
text.zh: Review 应检查承载 Claim 的 Object：Code、Data Transformation、Figure、Log、Proof、Protocol 或 Instrument Trace。Stepwise Verification 能在 Fluent Final Narrative 掩盖 Failure 之前定位问题。只要 LLM Judge 参与 Evaluator，这一点尤其重要。

text.en: Could an independent reviewer reproduce the claim from the released artifact without trusting the prose?
text.zh: Independent Reviewer 能否只依靠 Released Artifact 重现 Claim，而不是信任 Prose？

text.en: Every number on this site is paired with a task definition, denominator, evaluator, comparison basis, and claim authority. Author-reported results are useful signals, but they are not silently rewritten as independent validation. Evidence Grade A can mean peer-reviewed; it does not automatically mean independent replication.
text.zh: 本网站的每个数字都绑定 Task Definition、Denominator、Evaluator、Comparison Basis 与 Claim Authority。Author-reported Result 是有用 Signal，但不会被静默改写为 Independent Validation。Evidence Grade A 可以表示 Peer-reviewed，但不自动等于 Independent Replication。

statement.en: A valid Research OS evaluation should report the task, denominator, evaluator, comparison basis, and authority for every quantitative claim.
statement.zh: 有效的 Research OS Evaluation 应为每个 Quantitative Claim 报告 Task、Denominator、Evaluator、Comparison Basis 与 Authority。

taskDefinition.en: Audit quantitative claims across a Research OS benchmark and its released artifacts.
taskDefinition.zh: 审计 Research OS Benchmark 及其 Released Artifact 中的 Quantitative Claim。

sampleSizeDenominator.en: Every quantitative claim in the evaluated report; no claim is exempt.
sampleSizeDenominator.zh: 被评估报告中的每个 Quantitative Claim；不豁免任何 Claim。

evaluator.en: Artifact-aware human reviewer plus executable or source-grounded checks where available.
evaluator.zh: Artifact-aware Human Reviewer，加上可执行或 Source-grounded Check。

comparisonBasis.en: Claim metadata present versus claim metadata omitted, with the same underlying result.
comparisonBasis.zh: 比较同一 Result 下具有与缺少 Claim Metadata 的报告。

references.title: Autonomous Research Agents and the Verification Gap

title.zh: Vibe Research 如何真正运行？

dek.en: Keep human direction and judgment explicit while agents carry the repeatable throughput of research.
dek.zh: 明确保留 Human Direction 与 Judgment，让 Agent 承担可重复的 Research Throughput。

audience.en: For teams building a practical, inspectable workflow before attempting broader autonomy.
audience.zh: 面向希望在追求更高 Autonomy 前先构建 Practical、Inspectable Workflow 的团队。

text.en: Vibe Research is a division of labour. A human sets the question, taste, risk tolerance, and stopping rule; agents expand retrieval, coding, execution, comparison, and drafting. The arrangement is productive precisely because the human role is explicit rather than hidden inside an informal approval step.
text.zh: Vibe Research 是一种 Division of Labour。Human 设定 Question、Taste、Risk Tolerance 与 Stopping Rule；Agent 扩展 Retrieval、Coding、Execution、Comparison 与 Drafting。它之所以有效，正是因为 Human Role 被明确写出，而不是藏在非正式 Approval Step 里。

text.en: Delegate repeatable work; retain irreversible judgment.
text.zh: 把可重复工作委托出去；保留不可逆 Judgment。

values.en: Direction, taste, safety, claim ownership, and stop decisions.
values.zh: Direction、Taste、Safety、Claim Ownership 与 Stop Decision。

values.en: A brief with scope and intervention policy.
values.zh: 带 Scope 与 Intervention Policy 的 Brief。

values.en: Decomposition, budget, dependencies, and testable hypotheses.
values.zh: Decomposition、Budget、Dependency 与可测试 Hypothesis。

values.en: A source-grounded plan with alternatives and risks.
values.zh: 带 Source Grounding、Alternative 与 Risk 的 Plan。

values.en: Tool calls, code, environment, and artifact production.
values.zh: Tool Call、Code、Environment 与 Artifact Production。

values.en: Reproducible artifacts and failure records.
values.zh: 可复现 Artifact 与 Failure Record。

values.en: Checks, alternatives, uncertainty, and claim scope.
values.zh: Check、Alternative、Uncertainty 与 Claim Scope。

values.en: Evidence-linked interpretation, not a polished story only.
values.zh: Evidence-linked Interpretation，而不只是 Polished Story。

values.en: Artifact-aware acceptance, rejection, or escalation.
values.zh: Artifact-aware Acceptance、Rejection 或 Escalation。

values.en: A decision context that the next run can replay.
values.zh: 下一次 Run 可以 Replay 的 Decision Context。

text.en: Start with the smallest topology that can falsify the hypothesis. Single Agent loops are easier to attribute and replay. Parallel Subagents widen search but require deduplication and shared state. Role-specialized Teams can improve coverage, yet every extra boundary adds handoff loss, synchronization cost, and a new place for unsupported claims to enter.
text.zh: 从能够否证 Hypothesis 的最小 Topology 开始。Single Agent Loop 更容易 Attribution 与 Replay。Parallel Subagents 可以扩大 Search，但需要 Deduplication 与 Shared State。Role-specialized Team 可能提升 Coverage，但每增加一个 Boundary，就增加 Handoff Loss、Synchronization Cost，以及 Unsupported Claim 进入的入口。

title.zh: 把 Topology Choice 作为 Policy

description.zh: Coverage 与 Specialization；有 Handoff Risk。

text.en: A handoff is an intervention in the next agent's information state. Send the receiver what it needs to make the next decision, with source links, contradiction markers, confidence, and an explicit budget. Full transcripts preserve context but waste tokens; generic summaries save tokens but erase provenance. Receiver-conditioned, source-grounded, budget-constrained handoff is the practical middle path.
text.zh: Handoff 是对下一个 Agent Information State 的 Intervention。应提供 Receiver 做下一 Decision 所需的信息，并带 Source Link、Contradiction Marker、Confidence 与明确 Budget。Full Transcript 保留 Context 但浪费 Token；Generic Summary 节省 Token 却抹去 Provenance。Receiver-conditioned、Source-grounded、Budget-constrained Handoff 是更实用的中间路径。

items.en: State the decision the receiver must make.
items.zh: 写明 Receiver 必须作出的 Decision。

items.en: Attach source and artifact identifiers, not only conclusions.
items.zh: 附上 Source 与 Artifact Identifier，而不只是 Conclusion。

items.en: Mark uncertainty, contradiction, and rejected alternatives.
items.zh: 标注 Uncertainty、Contradiction 与 Rejected Alternative。

items.en: Spend tokens where they change downstream utility.
items.zh: 把 Token 花在能改变 Downstream Utility 的信息上。

text.en: Memory should preserve the shape of evidence, not merely the gist of a conversation. Store observations separately from interpretations; keep contradictions as edges rather than overwriting them; record failed experiments and why a decision changed; and link every durable finding to the artifact that produced it. Learned memory is useful only when retrieval can be audited.
text.zh: Memory 应保存 Evidence 的结构，而不只是 Conversation 的大意。将 Observation 与 Interpretation 分开；把 Contradiction 作为 Edge 保存，而不是覆盖；记录 Failed Experiment 与 Decision 改变的原因；并把每个 Durable Finding 连接到产生它的 Artifact。只有 Retrieval 可审计时，Learned Memory 才真正有用。

text.en: Evidence · Contradiction · Failure · Decision Context · Artifact Lineage
text.zh: Evidence · Contradiction · Failure · Decision Context · Artifact Lineage

values.en: Low-stakes, reversible, well-specified loops.
values.zh: 低风险、可逆、定义清晰的 Loop。

values.en: Silent failure and unreviewed drift.
values.zh: Silent Failure 与 Unreviewed Drift。

values.en: High-stakes or irreversible actions.
values.zh: High-stakes 或不可逆 Action。

values.en: Human bottleneck and rubber-stamping.
values.zh: Human Bottleneck 与 Rubber-stamping。

values.en: Stable workflows with known phase boundaries.
values.zh: Phase Boundary 已知的 Stable Workflow。

values.en: Missed failures between checkpoints.
values.zh: Checkpoint 之间错过 Failure。

values.en: Uncertainty, contradiction, safety, or evaluator-drift signals are observable.
values.zh: 可观察到 Uncertainty、Contradiction、Safety 或 Evaluator-drift Signal。

values.en: Trigger calibration and alert fatigue.
values.zh: Trigger Calibration 与 Alert Fatigue。

text.en: The goal is not to remove humans from the loop. It is to make intervention legible, timely, and proportionate to the risk of the next action.
text.zh: 目标不是把 Human 从 Loop 中移除，而是让 Intervention 对下一 Action 的 Risk 来说可解释、及时且比例适当。

text.en: Instrument-facing systems change the cost of error. Before a tool can move from simulation to a physical instrument, define permissions, safe states, calibration checks, abort paths, human confirmation points, and a complete execution trace. A successful protocol run is evidence of bounded operation; it is not by itself evidence of a new scientific finding.
text.zh: Instrument-facing System 会改变 Error Cost。Tool 从 Simulation 进入 Physical Instrument 前，应定义 Permission、Safe State、Calibration Check、Abort Path、Human Confirmation Point 与完整 Execution Trace。Protocol Run 成功只能证明 Bounded Operation，不能单独证明 New Scientific Finding。

items.en: Sandbox first: validate commands and limits before physical execution.
items.zh: 先 Sandbox：在 Physical Execution 前验证 Command 与 Limit。

items.en: Fail safe: preserve a human-controlled abort path.
items.zh: Fail Safe：保留 Human-controlled Abort Path。

items.en: Log raw instrument output, not only an agent summary.
items.zh: 记录 Raw Instrument Output，而不只是 Agent Summary。

items.en: Require independent review for irreversible or safety-critical steps.
items.zh: 对不可逆或 Safety-critical Step 要求 Independent Review。

items.en: Write a one-page brief with question, scope, owner, stop rule, and evidence boundary.
items.zh: 写一页 Brief，包含 Question、Scope、Owner、Stop Rule 与 Evidence Boundary。

items.en: Choose the smallest agent topology that can falsify the next hypothesis.
items.zh: 选择足以否证下一个 Hypothesis 的最小 Agent Topology。

items.en: Define the evaluator and matched budget before the first run.
items.zh: 在第一次 Run 前定义 Evaluator 与 Matched Budget。

items.en: Persist source-grounded handoffs, failed experiments, contradictions, and decision context.
items.zh: 持久保存 Source-grounded Handoff、Failed Experiment、Contradiction 与 Decision Context。

items.en: Review artifacts and claim scope at declared checkpoints or risk signals.
items.zh: 在声明的 Checkpoint 或 Risk Signal 出现时 Review Artifact 与 Claim Scope。

items.en: Replay the final artifact and record what remains author-reported.
items.zh: Replay Final Artifact，并记录哪些结论仍是 Author-reported。

text.en: Vibe Research / Human-on-the-loop: agents own throughput; humans own direction, safety, and scientific claims.
text.zh: Vibe Research / Human-on-the-loop：Agent 负责 Throughput；Human 负责 Direction、Safety 与 Scientific Claim。

scope.en: Robin, Co-Scientist, AutoLabs, and the X-ray Scientist show different points on the instrument-facing ladder.
scope.zh: Robin、Co-Scientist、AutoLabs 与 X-ray Scientist 展示 Instrument-facing Ladder 上的不同位置。

boundary.en: Their peer-reviewed or real-world status does not remove human safety, execution, or replication boundaries.
boundary.zh: Peer-reviewed 或 Real-world Status 不会消除 Human Safety、Execution 或 Replication Boundary。
